summary.tldr: Authorizes $8.75 billion for federal public service spending in 2021-22.
what_it_does: Authorizes $8,749,898,306 to be paid from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
Provides money for certain expenses of the public service of Canada that were not otherwise provided for in the fiscal year ending 31 March 2022.
Came into force on Royal Assent on 17 December 2021.
summary.background: It is an appropriation bill. It was introduced in the House of Commons on 9 December 2021 and received Royal Assent on 17 December 2021.
